title: Distance to the nearest constant function
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, its distance to the nearest constant function is the smaller of its relative Hamming distances from the two constant functions with values $1$ and $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs
